optimizedContext.value:
# Language Adapter

## Rules
- `LanguageAdapter` is stateless synchronous deterministic interface with required `languages()`, `extensions()`, `resolutionManifests()`, `analyzeFile`, `resolveImports`, `buildRelations`; optional cohesive facets `packageResolution`, `relativeImportResolution`, `qualifiedNameResolution`, `symbolReferenceSyntax`, `reExportLinking`. Facet presence declares full service; no partial facets or language/extension/manifest compensation branches.
- `resolutionManifests()` returns exact nonempty basenames, performs no I/O, and names every manifest actually used. TypeScript returns `["package.json"]`.
- `analyzeFile(filePath, content, context)` parses once and emits complete compact `FileAnalysisDraft`: symbols, imports, deterministic binding/call facts, namespace, optional serializable parser state. Never retain AST nodes, parser trees, or heavyweight runtime objects.
- `resolveImports` and `buildRelations` consume stored facts plus `IndexSession`; no content reread, reparsing, whole-symbol scans, or per-candidate filesystem probes. Indexer derives file `IMPORTS`; adapters emit deterministic concrete relations or proven loader imports. `DEPENDS_ON` remains spec-only.
- All core/facet methods are synchronous, deterministic, side-effect-free outside session. Only `packageResolution.identity` and `packageResolution.prepare` may perform I/O. Compact run-scoped cache state goes through `IndexSession`.
- Registry builds language/extension mappings dynamically; validates public adapters atomically and throws `SpecdError` code `INVALID_LANGUAGE_ADAPTER` for invalid core, declarations, manifests, or facets. Later registration replaces matching languages/extensions; orphaned adapters leave `getAdapters()`. Unknown extensions skip silently.
- Facet absence leaves behavior unresolved without heuristic/error; absent package facet is reported once in `importDiagnostics.adaptersWithoutPackageResolution`. Facet failure is isolated: per-file errors remain local; `identity`/`prepare`/`link` failure disables package-addressed behavior for adapter, drops solely claimed identities, preserves independent relative re-export linking.
- `packageResolution`: `identity` searches usable manifest from canonical `codeRoot` upward, bounded by detected `repoRoot`; without repo root inspect only code root. Report unreadable/identity-less manifests and continue. `prepare` runs once after Pass 1, reads each workspace manifest at most once, retains compact immutable facts. `matchSpecifier` and `entrySurface` use prepared session only, never I/O or symbol-name search. Entries are ordered indexed non-test files with public surfaces.
- Package manifests/identity: TypeScript `package.json.name`; Python `pyproject.toml` `[project].name`; Go `go.mod module`; PHP `composer.json.name`. Project root, code root, package root remain distinct; Go package paths derive from package root. Duplicate package identity across workspaces is ambiguous; same workspace identity from multiple adapters is valid. Inaccessible workspace yields diagnostic, not run failure.
- Relative import facet returns candidate file IDs without I/O or choosing. Qualified-name facet builds canonical names and resolves paths only from prepared session metadata.
- Package import helpers `packageEntryFiles` and `resolvePackageExport` own generic lookup. Export resolves only when all requested spaces/entries agree on one logical target; stable unresolved reasons: `facet-absent`, `package-unknown`, `no-entry-surface`, `not-exported`, `ambiguous`. Adapters never choose first/unique same-name workspace symbol. Persist resolution steps; keep diagnostics non-persisted. External `package-unknown` counts only in `externalPackageImports`.
- Re-export linking runs after all Pass 1 analyses and preparation, before Pass 2 imports. Relative routes use relative facet; package routes use same package entry surface as imports. Binding surface is re-exporting file; target is already-published logical ID, including cross-workspace. One unresolved/ambiguous entry emits no guessed binding.
- Parser-authoritative extraction: derive declarations, imports, calls/construction, bindings, referenced types, scopes, ranges, and hierarchy from parser nodes when available; regex/text only for unsupported constructs or manifest metadata. Strings/comments never create facts.
- Calls use innermost callable caller and proven local/import/receiver/session callee. Shared pipeline owns scope/shadowing/candidate filtering. Drop top-level, ambiguous, dynamic, runtime/reflection/container, monkey-patch, and interprocedural cases.
- Capability flags truthfully describe shared facts plus ordered provenance for declarations, members, bindings, hierarchy, build context; facets are separate. Unsupported capability records coverage; generic resolver never guesses or receives adapter syntax.
- Member-capable adapter establishes logical owner before member identity, emits `MemberSemantics`, and sets lexical occurrence `parentId` with strict scope popping. Top-level has no owner; same-name members under distinct owners remain distinct.
- Symbol reference facet parses human/native text into explicit owner-then-member candidates and renders generic plus optional native spelling. Canonical/structured requests bypass parser; shared domain never splits `.`; dynamic/ambiguous input remains unresolved.
- Every symbol uses parser-derived half-open complete construct range plus contained exact `selectionRange`; omit untrustworthy candidate and report gap.
- Declaration policy classifies each supported role as logical+physical, lexical binding, physical-only, or unsupported using role, scope, visibility, owner, and language semantics; broad `SymbolKind` is insufficient.
- Hierarchy support emits consistent facts, ordered traversal provenance, and resolvable `EXTENDS`/`IMPLEMENTS`/`OVERRIDES`; unsupported precedence/build/dynamic alternatives record gap, never guesses.
- Built-in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Go, PHP adapters pass reusable conformance suite: ranges, caller containment, scope isolation, logical owners, declaration grouping, physical-only facts, multi-occurrence resolution, coverage after impact, unresolved-import safety, hierarchy provenance, no post-prepare metadata reads, clean/incremental equivalence. Language-specific specs may tighten, never weaken shared safety.
- Adding language changes only adapter implementation/registration/spec/docs: implement core, truthful capabilities/policy, complete supported facets, exact manifests, validate registration, pass conformance. No indexer/session/resolver/store change. `docs/code-graph/language-adapters.md` mirrors contract.

## Constraints
- Interface, not abstract class; no shared mutable adapter state.
- Plain compact parser/session state only; no retained AST/parser runtime.
- No `@specd/core` dependency.
- No language-specific indexer resolution logic, fuzzy/runtime inference, or Pass 2 filesystem probing.
- Dynamic/unresolvable calls, loaders, includes, imports, hierarchy targets drop without guessed graph relation.
- Tree-sitter/ast-grep queries remain private.
- TypeScript adapter registered by default.
